card.name: Repeated drug label warning sentences
card.fires_on: Fires on one word inside a few repeated label sentences, such as 'cause' after 'isolates of C. difficile' and 'severe' after 'or who exhibit'. It also fires weakly on 'an' in '(e.g., anaphylaxis)'.

modes.label: C. difficile hypertoxin sentence
modes.description: The verb 'cause' after 'Hypertoxin producing isolates of C. difficile'.
modes.example: Hypertoxin producing isolates of C. difficile<< cause>> increased morbidity and mortality, as these

modes.label: Aspirin triad sentence
modes.description: The word 'severe' after 'or who exhibit' in the aspirin-triad description.
modes.example: or who exhibit<< severe>>, potentially fatal bronchospasm after

modes.label: Split word in warnings
modes.description: The start of a word split across pieces, such as 'an' in anaphylaxis.
modes.example: Hypersensitivity to hydrocodone or acetaminophen (e.g.,<< an>>aphylaxis) [see Warnings
